title: Thailand Dealer Network Sales
thesis: On one governed platform, Snowflake turns daily booking activity from 40 synthetic Thai vehicle dealers into booking-integrity KPIs, a 7-day booking-cancellation risk score per dealer, finance decline rate anomalies and AI answers that cite their sources.

talking_points: 40 dealers of a fictional distributor sell five vehicle segments in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Khon Kaen, Chon Buri and Hat Yai; the cards show clean booking rate, booking issues, cancelled bookings and booking value in THB.
Each KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so you can trace it back to dealer-day rows.
The issue-type chart separates issues that often end in a lost booking, such as declined finance applications, from flood-related delivery disruptions that are always resolved.
tabs.call_out: Dealer sales KPIs you can trace to source rows

transition.line: Which dealers need a sales review first?

talking_points: A Snowflake ML classifier estimates, per dealer, the chance of a cancelled booking in the next 7 days.
Precision and recall come from the most recent labelled days held out of training, shown next to the base rate.
Anomaly detection picks out unusual dealer finance decline rates, and the forecast covers the next 14 days of booking issues for sales desk staffing.
tabs.call_out: ML that is evaluated honestly, next to the data

transition.line: Are dealers keeping yard stock and documents in order?

talking_points: Stock audit compliance, dealer document coverage and pending documents show where dealer controls are slipping.
Plotting stock audit compliance against cancelled bookings per dealer shows where the two move together; that is an association, not a cause.
The action memo proposes three prioritised actions using only the KPI, dealer, issue-type and risk rows.

transition.line: What happens when a booking hits a problem right now?

talking_points: New booking events arrive in RAW.LIVE_BOOKINGS, either from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The alert records each ISSUE event with an SOP hint and the dealer risk band, then emails the on-call dealer sales analyst.
tabs.call_out: From a live booking issue to a dealer case on one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers metric questions with Cortex Analyst over the semantic view, and procedure questions with Cortex Search over 13 synthetic booking-issue SOPs.
Every answer shows the SQL it generated and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Answers in plain language that you can check

transition.line: This is how it fits together.

talking_points: One core supports two builds: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake with Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q.
All data shown is synthetic and rebuilds the same way from the repo.
tabs.call_out: A governed core with an optional AWS edge
